proposals.evidence: Turner baddha bound explicitly gives western Pahari bado/bāddhe/baddhɔ all and Gujarati bādhũ whole/entire. The Jaunsari and Bhil/Bareli all responses fit this bound-together > whole/all family, with local vowels, gemination and aspiration retained. This is a comparative family assignment; neighbouring contact may also have contributed to its distribution.
